title: Just what I was looking for
text: I was looking for a tea sampler and found this subscription box.  I felt that the price was right for what I was expecting.  When I got the box, I was a bit surprised by how small it was. Then I took a moment to think about it.  Tea really doesn't weigh much (unlike coffee) and you don't need much to brew a cup.  After opening the box I saw the introduction and tea info pages, four pouches of tea, and four cloth tea bags.  I thought that the overall packaging was done very well.  The packages are color coded depending on if you got all black, green, herbal, mix.  Generally, I do not enjoy fruity teas, and my herbal was a mandarin orange with a rooibos base.  It smelled delicious so I went ahead and gave it a try. I followed the directions that came with the tea and ended up with a lovely cup of tea that had excellent color and taste.  I added a touch of sweetener and suddenly I'm drinking mandarin candy. I'm a convert. My final thoughts on this subscription is that it's a great buy, I look forward to another package, and it's lovely tea. If I were going to add/change anything, it would be that with the first subscription box that they include a spoon for the tea. That would be a handy nice touch.
label: positive
